{{Top|leg}}
A '''TracSheet''' was a document used both by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to record charges against active criminals in the jurisdiction of that government. TracSheets were distributed either in a limited area if the offenses were considered to be unimportant, or in a wide area if the crimes were severe, in any case to any member of a [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] force.

A TracSheet included information such as the name, [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Gender/Legends|sex]], height, age, description and one image of the fugitive, the criminal activities and charges against that person, and details on the criminal's modus operandi. The TracSheet commonly also included a recorded utterance of the individual to provide an insight on the outlaw's mind. Each TracSheet had a unique code including eight numeric characters, a hyphen, four alphabetic characters, a hyphen, and five to six numeric characters. Some TracSheets were used as a basis to post a bounty.
